title: AdicUnitTraceConstruction
statement: Let $D$ be a finite-field datum and $C$ its coefficient datum with prime $\ell\ne p$ and fixed algebraic closure $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$. Let $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ be finite inside this closure. Let $f:X\to Y$ be a smooth separated morphism of pure relative dimension $d\in\mathbf N$ between separated finite-type $D.k$-schemes, and let $S$ be the specified coefficient-compatible compact-support/exceptional adjunction system on the uniform finite-Tor constructible categories. Construction is the normalized data of the unit trace, completed projection and exceptional-adjunction assembly from a fixed base trace. It includes the canonical finite right realization, coefficient-unit constraint, twist/tensor comparison and inverse actual projection. It contains a natural transformation whose components equal the displayed adjoint transposes, their coefficient linearity including the Hom bijection, equality of all positive reductions with prescribed finite smooth purity, invertibility of every component, all normalized finite trace reductions and the finite scalar-trace equation at cofinal levels. Uses [def-pur-unit-trace-scalar-data], [def-pur-adic-projection-trace-data], [def-pur-adic-scalar-trace-data], [def-pur-completed-unit-pullback-data], [def-pur-adic-purity-objects], [def-pur-adic-source-reduction], [def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model], [def-sf-integral-system-canonical-bridge], [def-pur-site-sheaf-tensor-presentation-data], [def-pur-finite-compact-support-scalar-data], [def-pur-finite-trace-presentation-data].
